# FindLegalForms.com - Indian Legal Forms

> A comprehensive repository of attorney-prepared, downloadable legal forms and templates tailored for Indian jurisdictions across family law, real estate, business, and personal matters.

FindLegalForms.com provides ready-to-use legal documents drafted by attorneys, enabling individuals and businesses to handle common legal matters efficiently without extensive legal consultation. The platform covers a wide range of document categories from family law and property transactions to employment agreements and financial instruments.

## Family Law & Estate Planning

- [Divorce Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/divorce): Divorce and separation agreement forms for India
- [Family Law Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/family-law): Family law forms covering divorce, prenuptial, and child support
- [Will and Living Trust Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/wills): Will and living trust forms for estate planning in India
- [Name Change Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/name-change): Name change forms for marriage, divorce, and affidavits in India

## Real Estate & Property Transfer

- [Real Estate Legal Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/real-estate): Real estate forms including property sale and lease agreements
- [Deed Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/deeds): Deed forms including quitclaim and warranty deeds for property transfer
- [Bill of Sale Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/bill-of-sale): Bill of sale forms for property, vehicle, and animal sales in India
- [Landlord & Tenant Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/landlord-and-tenant): Landlord and tenant forms including apartment and commercial leases

## Financial & Lending Documents

- [Promissory Note Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/promissory-notes): Attorney-prepared promissory note forms for loans and payments
- [Borrowing, Lending & Credit Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/borrowing-lending-and-collections): Borrowing, lending, and credit forms including promissory notes for India

## Business & Employment Forms

- [Business Legal Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/business): Business legal forms including asset purchase and hire-purchase agreements
- [Employment Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/employment): Employment agreements and HR forms including contractor agreements
- [Confidentiality Agreement and NDA Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/confidentiality): Non-disclosure and confidentiality agreement forms for India

## Legal Documentation & Attestation

- [Affidavit and Declaration Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/affidavits): Attorney-prepared affidavit and declaration forms for India
- [Power of Attorney Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/power-of-attorney): Power of attorney forms including general and durable POA for India
- [Release Forms](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/releases): Release and indemnification forms for liability waivers and claims

## Legal Notices & Correspondence

- [Legal Notices](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/notices): Legal notices including board meeting and payment default notices
- [Legal Letters](https://india.findlegalforms.com/forms/letters): Lawyer-drafted legal letters including cease-and-desist correspondence
